newsitem.title: USA: Masco acquires bath accessories firm.
newsitem.headline: Masco acquires bath accessories firm.

text.p: Masco Corp. said Thursday it has acquired Franklin Brass Manufacturing Co., a maker of bath accessories and bath safety products with annual sales of about $45 million.
Franklin Brass, based in the Los Angeles suburb of Rancho Dominguez, will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of Masco. Its top management team will remain in place.
Masco, a maker of home improvement and building products best known for its Delta and Peerless faucets and Merillat cabinetry, said Franklin Brass products would broaden its product range.
Taylor, Mich.-based Masco's stock edged up 12.5 cents to $35.625 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
